topics.topic: Deterministic rule for which error/failure is reported first when multiple conditions fail
questions: If more than one refusal condition is true (for example empty corpus and a named unknown case), which check must be evaluated and reported first?
For a `many` input with multiple invalid elements, what deterministic element-check order defines the first reported failure?
When phase 7 or phase 9 fails in multiple places, which exact node/edge/output must be reported as the single "first" failure?

quotes:
A request naming
   an unknown case, a case of another contract version, or one case twice is
   refused before anything executes, and so is a try on an empty corpus, as
   `empty_corpus`.
judgement.why: This topic targets unchanged State 2 ordering text, and the reopen diff did not touch these passages or make their behavior newly material.

topics.topic: Behavior when a request references a non-existent or context/type-invalid target
questions: What must happen when the requested node_id does not exist in that flow version, or exists but is not an operation node with an effect class (for example a function node)?
How is a resolution request handled when the attempt reference does not exist at all, or does not belong to the named run/node/element context?

topics.topic: Exact inputs included in request_digest computation for approval-related requests
questions: Exactly which headers and multipart part media types are included in request_digest, especially auto-generated headers (Host, Content-Length, User-Agent, multipart boundary)?

topics.topic: How `stored_value_bytes_max` applies to `many` value ports (per-element vs whole collection)
questions: For `many` value inputs/case values, is the size ceiling applied to the whole serialized array value, to each element, or to both?

topics.topic: Policy for creating and ordering synthetic non-executed NodeExecution records for nodes that cannot run
questions: What exact procedure defines the set of nodes that "become non-executable together" (especially through transitive `upstream_failed` / `skipped_by_guard` propagation across mapped elements)?
When a run ends `refused` or `cancelled`, should unconcluded downstream/independent nodes receive synthetic NodeExecution records (for example `upstream_failed`), or remain without node records?

topics.topic: Sandbox lifecycle granularity for mapped function node element executions
questions: For a mapped function node, is each element call a separate sandbox execution (fresh environment each time), or are all element calls made inside one sandbox instance?

topics.topic: When to create a replacement `requested` approval after an approved record no longer matches request_digest
questions: When an existing approved approval no longer matches `request_digest`, must the kernel create the replacement `requested` approval in the same advancing request, or only after a later user request reaches the node again?

topics.topic: Whether path-placeholder bindings to `file` carriage inputs must be rejected at proposal time
questions: Must a binding be refused at proposal time if a path placeholder names a `file` carriage input port?
